title: iPad Mini With A20 Pro, New HomePod Mini Colors, and New Apple TV 4K All Just Leaked
content:
The next iPad mini, HomePod mini, and Apple TV 4K models have all leaked, just a few weeks before the devices are expected to be announced. Specifically, MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris discovered a few of Apple's official images of the devices, confirming their existence and some new features that are planned.


The most notable iPad mini details revealed in today's leak include an A20 Pro chip, a new speaker design, and a landscape front camera, while images have revealed that the next HomePod mini will be available in new colors like green and pink.

There is also evidence of an upcoming "Apple TV 4K (4th generation)" model, so it appears that a new Apple TV is finally coming soon after a four-year wait.

We have recapped all of our coverage below:
  • iPad Mini 8 Leaked: A20 Pro Chip, Landscape Camera, and More

  • Exclusive: First Look at HomePod Mini 2 in Three New Colors

  • New Apple TV Leaked
October is a common month for Apple to announce products, so the new iPad mini, HomePod mini, and Apple TV 4K might be no more than a few weeks away.
